decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a transient E drop and platform between indices 485–544, possibly indicating a temporary offset or opposing motion; (2) a sharp, sustained E decline from ~605 onward with ambiguous recovery, possibly a permanent jump or slow slip. No clear single-edge events dominate; morphology suggests superposed changes.

regions.observation: N/E/U show a multi-sample drop in E (from ~3.3 to ~2.0) around index 495–500, followed by a sustained platform at lower E (~2.0–2.7) until ~520, then a gradual decline. U shows a concurrent rise and plateau, suggesting possible opposing motion or superposed offset; N is noisy but shows no clear coherent shift.

From ~610 onward, E drops sharply (~-14 to -12), then stabilizes near -13 to -14 with minor fluctuations; N remains relatively stable (~-9 to -11) but shows a subtle step-down around 620–630. U stays near -6 to -8 with no clear platform—suggests possible permanent offset in E with ambiguous return or ongoing slow motion.
